jobs.description: Prime Video brings together the world's best creators with the most passionate communities in a way that no other entertainment brand can. Not only are we a one-stop hub for distinctive, critically-acclaimed and award-winning original programming including TV series such as The Boys, Fallout and The Summer I Turned Pretty and movies like Project Hail Mary, Culpa Mea and The Sheep Detectives, but we offer a multi-dimensional experience that allows subscribers to fully immerse themselves in their fandom: to read the book, to listen to the soundtrack, to buy the costume, to replay live sports in real time, and more. That breadth of content and connection to the Amazon family of brands across Media & Entertainment, along with the support of a passionate and diverse global team, makes Prime Video a company where creators and makers of all kinds can build their future. We are excited to start building our theatrical feature marketing localization group and are seeking a Localization Producer to bring deep subject matter expertise to the team. The Localization Producer will report to a Localization Production lead and closely collaborate with cross functional peers across Theatrical Marketing, Studios Marketing and Amazon Studios Production and Mastering. The individual in this position will produce best-in-class localized marketing assets — including dubbed and subtitled trailers, TV/digital spots, key art, OOH, and metadata — for Amazon Originals films and series to ensure the highest creative and technical standards are met for global audiences across 240+ countries and territories. This role is a creative production leadership position that oversees the end-to-end development and delivery of localized A/V and print marketing materials. The Localization Producer will manage the creative localization pipeline — from asset acquisition and creative adaptation through casting, recording, mix, QC, and final delivery — ensuring that localized assets maintain the creative intent and quality bar of the original campaign while resonating with local audiences. They will serve as the primary creative production liaison between Amazon Studios Production, Studios Marketing, and third-party localization vendors, providing creative oversight and technical expertise across dubbing, subtitling, artwork adaptation, and versioning workflows. This role requires a subject matter expert in localization production pipelines, A/V finishing processes, and creative adaptation who can advocate for quality creative output while managing high-volume deliverables against demanding global release timetables. Key job responsibilities Creative Asset Development & Production Oversight Produce localized marketing campaigns for Amazon Originals series and films, overseeing the creative development of dubbed/subtitled trailers, TV spots, digital spots, audio assets, key art, OOH and metadata across multiple languages and regions Oversee the creative adaptation and finishing of A/V and print marketing materials through the localization pipeline — including translation/adaptation, voice casting, recording direction, mix, conform, and versioning — ensuring creative intent is preserved Vendor Management & Creative Partner Coordination Own communications with vendors for localization production, supervising the creative development and finishing of assets through contracted partners across dubbing studios, subtitle vendors, and artwork adaptation houses Production Pipeline & Asset Management Manage end-to-end production timelines for localized asset development, providing timeline inputs to cross-functional leads and proactively flagging milestone risks Oversee asset acquisition from producing entities and route materials through the creative localization workflow — tracking all assets from source receipt through adaptation, production, QC, and final delivery Build and maintain production asset trackers; manage the creation and upkeep of vendor asset management systems for titles across the portfolio Ensure content security protocols are upheld throughout the creative production process Quality Control & Creative Standards Oversee QC of all localized deliverables — evaluating creative quality of dubs, subtitle timing/accuracy, artwork fidelity, technical specs compliance, and format/placement requirements Troubleshoot creative and technical rejections from upstream (source asset issues) and downstream (publishing/platform rejections), driving resolution with appropriate stakeholders Budget & Operational Management Own the localization production budget for assigned titles in conjunction with Business Operations; manage billing negotiations, review and open POs, track invoices and vendor spend Identify creative production efficiencies and cost optimization opportunities without compromising quality Cross-Functional Creative Collaboration Partner with Studios Marketing creative teams to understand campaign creative intent and ensure localization preserves the vision Collaborate with Finishing Producers to align on source asset readiness and localization timelines Coordinate with regional marketing POCs to incorporate local market creative insights and cultural adaptation requirements About the team Our mission is to ensure Prime Video is able to deliver on the promise of a globally consistent customer experience through centralized program management across globally connected priorities. , we are investing in new tools and workflows to push the boundaries of what our creative work can achieve, and this role will play a key part in shaping that future.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

As a Principal Security Software Engineer on the Production IAM team, you will set the technical direction for how identity and access work across Roblox's production infrastructure, from the mTLS-based identity that services use to authenticate to one another, to the privileged access controls that govern how engineers reach production. As AI agents become first-class actors in production, you will also help pioneer how they get identity, prove who they are, and receive safely-scoped access.
You will
Lead the architecture for production identity and access.
Define and evolve the end-to-end design for machine, workload, human, and AI-agent identity across our hybrid on-prem and cloud fleet, making secure access invisible when it can be and intuitive when it needs attention.
Drive mTLS and workload identity to full production enforcement.
Lead the technical strategy for our SPIFFE/SPIRE-based identity platform, service-mesh integration, managed service accounts, and certificate issuance, storage, and rotation.
Advance just-in-time, least-privilege access for engineers.
Architect just-in-time, least-privilege, and break-glass access to production, replacing static, long-lived credentials with short-lived, auditable access that stays reliable even during dependency or identity-provider outages.
Evolve the centralized authorization engine and a secure golden path.
Mature our centralized authorization engine and the access-control models behind it (RBAC/ABAC and risk-based access) so decisions are consistent, fine-grained, and testable.
Pioneer identity and access for AI agents.
Define how agents obtain credentials, receive scoped permissions, and have their sessions managed across their lifecycle, setting the patterns for agentic identity at Roblox..
Lead across the org and raise the bar.
Author RFCs and multi-year roadmaps, align stakeholders across Roblox Platform, mentor senior and staff engineers, and raise the technical bar through design review, on-call ownership, and hiring.
You have
8+ years of relevant professional experience building scalable, distributed backend systems, with a track record of driving architecture end to end.
Deep expertise in identity and access management — authentication, authorization, and access-control models such as RBAC, ABAC, or risk-based access control.
Hands-on experience with several of: PKI and certificate/key lifecycle management, mTLS, SPIFFE/SPIRE or comparable workload-identity systems, service mesh, secret management (e.g., Vault), and privileged access management (PAM).
Proficiency in at least one systems language such as Go, Rust, Java, C++, Python, or C# .NET, and a habit of building systems rather than only configuring vendor tools.
Experience leading the technical work of other engineers — setting direction across teams, writing influential design docs, and mentoring senior talent.
AI fluency: you use AI tools in your daily workflow, understand LLM capabilities and limitations, and can reason about what it means to give an AI agent an identity and permissions.
A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field.
You are
A systems thinker.
You reason about failure modes, blast radius, and reliability, and you design access that stays secure and available even when dependencies fail.
Security-minded and pragmatic.
You are passionate about least privilege and zero trust, but you optimize for the Builder experience and adoption, not controls for their own sake.
A force multiplier.
You make the engineers and teams around you better through mentorship, clear writing, and high-quality technical leadership.
A strong communicator.
You translate deep technical tradeoffs for both engineers and executives, and you build alignment across organizational boundaries.
Bar-raising and hands-on.
You still love to build, and you set the standard for engineering quality on the hardest problems.
